worldcombat.skill.woodhammer.summary: Harden the body into a wooden mallet, rear up and slam down: a hit deals heavy damage, hurls the target and staggers its Speed, the ground around the landing cracks (and mends later), and the user takes recoil. Defence feeds the power, and a hard body softens the recoil.
worldcombat.skill.woodhammer.description: The slam deals %1$s contact damage, reaching %2$s blocks after rearing %3$s blocks, with a %4$s block collision radius.
On a hit the user takes %1$s of the actual damage as recoil, hurls the target %2$s blocks and drops its Speed %3$s stage(s); %4$s ground blocks around the landing are cracked.
worldcombat.skill.woodhammer.root.on: Rooted form: more power, knockback and cracked ground, but heavier recoil and a slower wind-up and recovery.
worldcombat.skill.woodhammer.root.off: Mobile form: a quicker swing, trading power and cracked ground down a step.
worldcombat.skill.woodhammer.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.woodhammer.growth.0: From level %1$s the slam power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.woodhammer.growth.1: From level %1$s the slam power rises to %2$s and the Speed drop to %3$s stage(s).
worldcombat.skill.woodhammer.use.0: Slam a tough target up close
worldcombat.skill.woodhammer.use.1: Stagger a target and strip its Speed
worldcombat.skill.woodhammer.use.2: Leave cracked ground marking where the blow landed
On: more power, knockback and cracked ground, but heavier recoil and a slower wind-up and recovery - for a finishing blow or breaking a formation. Off (mobile form): a quicker swing, trading power and cracked ground down a step, for a long fight.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. The move is short ranged, so a larger value is easier to dodge while moving.
Below this health fraction the user stops starting slams (unless the target is nearly down). Higher is more protective.
On: prefer sleeping or rooted targets - the slow swing is saved for one that cannot dodge. Off: rank by threat and distance alone.
